_readme: Copy this file into <team's .vibecheck bundle>/facilitator-scorecard.json, then edit every field below. Remove this _readme key and every other _comment key before saving — the scorer ignores underscore-prefixed keys, but leaving placeholder text in a real value (e.g. an unedited badge id) will show up on the leaderboard.
team: REPLACE — team name as it should appear on the leaderboard

demo._comment: 0-10, watched live by a facilitator. Required for the 'It Actually Works' dimension to score at all — without this object it stays unscored, not zero.
demo.note: REPLACE — one sentence on what you actually saw run.

_acceptance_comment: The event's own acceptance checklist, worth 5 points, scored in proportion to how many steps you saw working. Copy the array from your event's checklist file (start from docs/acceptance-checklist.template.json, or an instance such as docs/examples/acceptance-checklist.desk-booking.json) and set `met` on each entry as you watch the demo. Leave it as [] and the criterion stays unscored rather than zero — so an event that does not use a checklist loses nothing.

privacy._comment: Worth 2 points. Deliberately a person's judgement and never a scan: an invented ana@example.com and a real colleague's address are the same string shape, and a regex that guesses between them would accuse teams wrongly. Ask the team where their seed data came from, look at a few records, and record what you found. Omit this object entirely and the criterion stays unscored rather than zero.
privacy.note: REPLACE — e.g. 'seed data is generated, no real names or addresses' or, if not met, what you saw.

_badges_comment: Add zero or more of these ids as plain strings in the array above: caught-the-ai-being-wrong, responsible-disclosure, useful-skill, best-question. The rest of the badge catalogue (Tight Loop, Clean Hands, etc.) is awarded automatically from the evidence — do not add those here.
_adjustment_comment: To apply a manual point change, replace the null above with: { "points": -3, "reason": "why, in your own words" }. A reason is mandatory — an adjustment object with no reason is rejected and applies nothing. Leave it as null when there is no adjustment.
